calls.title: Stephen & James
calls.summary: The meeting addressed the finalization of the experimentation platform contract, emphasizing key success criteria such as AA test stability and data accuracy tailored to NECO Health’s needs. The team aims for swift procurement approval, with a clear drafting process to expedite contract signing. Onboarding activities are set to begin immediately post-signature, with sessions scheduled for Thursday or Friday. Data integration has become a priority following the recent NECO Health website launch, ensuring a seamless flow of information into existing systems. During the trial period, real live tests will be conducted to validate the platform's effectiveness. Clear communication strategies are established for smooth collaboration throughout the process, highlighting the teams' eagerness to start the project.
calls.keywords: Experimentation Platform, Procurement Contract, AA Testing, Onboarding, Data Integration, NECO Health Website
calls.action_items:
**James Shannon**
Draft contract including three success criteria: successful AA test runs, integration into existing systems, and data accuracy; confirm repurposability of legal templates for NECO's needs (11:14)
Prepare and send the contract PDF to Stephen for upload to the procurement platform to enable signature processing (16:01)
Schedule onboarding kickoff calls for Thursday afternoon or Wednesday daytime, coordinating with engineering and onboarding teams to facilitate platform adoption (14:48)
Rally internal stakeholders and legal team to prepare and support contract and onboarding timeline (15:41)

**Stephen Pavlovich**
Upload the received contract to the procurement platform and verify the signing process including DocuSign usage (11:45)
Sign up internal team members using NECO Health corporate emails and initiate initial platform account setup (14:11)
Coordinate and confirm availability for onboarding kickoff meetings, targeting Thursday or Wednesday time slots (14:48)
Provide phone number and preferred communication channels for follow-ups considering upcoming travel schedule (16:30)
